notes: DISPATCH 3 (2026-08-24) — SINGLE-DIE RULED OUT on the SPINE HEIGHT, and the REASON is now correct where the prior one was not. The obstacle is NOT area: 114 cells (110 + 4 parity pads) fit a 120-cell array. Every stage's out needs its own ctl directly above it and the next stage's ctl directly below, so the ctl/out spine is 2*n_stages rows in ONE column — 14 for 7 stages, against a 12-row array. That is not negotiable, so FFT128Block raises LargeFFTGeometryError naming the 2-row shortfall rather than emitting an unroutable layout, and the message is gated. The stage-boundary 2-DIE SPLIT is the supported topology at this size and is NOT built: it was correctly not started, because the N=64 single-die question had to be settled first (it was — see FFT64Block) and N=64 is not yet bit-exact, so a 2-die N=128 would inherit an unverified stage. All N=128 ARITHMETIC remains verified: the octant fold bit-exact including the strided stage-1 case, every cell inside 32 words.
